notes: The 2027 close date and hiring fair date are not posted yet.
name: ProX Summer Internship Program
org: ProX (Professional Experiences for Kansas City Youth)
what_you_do: A five-week paid summer internship with a Kansas City employer in fields like healthcare, marketing, engineering and real estate. You do workshops, then interview at a hiring fair. No experience needed.
who_can_apply: Current 9th to 12th graders ages 14 to 19. You live and go to high school in Jackson, Clay, Platte or Cass counties in Missouri, or Johnson or Wyandotte counties in Kansas. You must meet employer hiring and work rules.
deadline_text: Page says check back in early January 2027 for summer 2027 applications (exact date not posted). 2026 applications closed Feb 20, 2026; the hiring fair was Mar 21, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form. Finish the paperwork. Go to a prep workshop. Then interview at the spring hiring fair.
